Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-transcribe-medium-0112-reverse-01", "row_sha256": "79c7eb7b151ea7016618a469c593add6f30e345192698d08ab8fa26f24af5d65", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "the courier texted me on monday morning to say our parcel would be ready for pickup at the depot after lunch and asked me to bring photo identification and the collection code i had written the code on the back of the grocery list so i put the list beside my keys before leaving my sister was at home and checked the tracking page because the delivery notice still showed the old estimated date when i reached the counter the clerk scanned the code and weighed the parcel again the actual pickup charge was $101.38 not $49.11 the lower number belonged to a small box we collected last month and was not the amount due today i paid by card and asked for a printed receipt because the email receipt sometimes arrives late the clerk put the parcel in a paper bag and handed it over i called my sister from the car to confirm i had it then drove home and left it on the kitchen table until she came back from work the label had our apartment number and my sister's name and the clerk had checked both before releasing it i kept the receipt with the delivery notice in the drawer by the phone", "output": "The courier texted me on Monday morning to say our parcel would be ready for pickup at the depot after lunch and asked me to bring photo identification and the collection code. I had written the code on the back of the grocery list, so I put the list beside my keys before leaving. My sister was at home and checked the tracking page because the delivery notice still showed the old estimated date. When I reached the counter, the clerk scanned the code and weighed the parcel again. The actual pickup charge was $101.38, not $49.11. The lower number belonged to a small box we collected last month and was not the amount due today. I paid by card and asked for a printed receipt because the email receipt sometimes arrives late. The clerk put the parcel in a paper bag and handed it over. I called my sister from the car to confirm I had it, then drove home and left it on the kitchen table until she came back from work. The label had our apartment number and my sister's name, and the clerk had checked both before releasing it. I kept the receipt with the delivery notice in the drawer by the phone."}]
